messages:
maria: kicking off the mini-harness acceptance contrasts for model-omega-v2 (post-quant+opt). goal: define pass/fail heuristics before canary deploy.

lee: nice — what's the minimal sample + metrics we want for this run?

maria: plan: 500 prompts from the 'mini_accept' suite (mix of instructions, summarization, and code). primary signals: instr-follow pass_rate, semantic-sim drop (emb cosine), and latency p95. secondary: nll/perplexity for generative drift.

david: can we put concrete thresholds? engineers need actionable numbers.

maria: initial thresholds proposed:
- instr-follow pass_rate >= 92% (relative to baseline)
- mean embedding cosine >= 0.985 (drop <= 1.5%)
- latency p95 <= baseline_p95 * 1.2
- toxicity false_positive delta <= 0.5%
- any catastrophic tokenization failures > 0 => fail

lee: for quantized variants (q4*), add acceptance margin: allow instr-follow dip up to 1.5% but require that examples failing are non-critical (we'll inspect).

eva: what about statistical significance? 500 might be small for tiny deltas. recommend bootstrapped CI and marking 'marginal' if CI crosses threshold.

maria: agreed. test logic: pass if point-estimate passes and 95% bootstrap CI does not cross fail boundary. marginal if CI crosses but point-estimate within allowed slack. fail otherwise.

sasha: can we automate artifact capture? need full outputs, token-level traces, and diffs vs baseline.

maria: yes — CI-bot will save artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/mini-contrasts/omega-v2/{run_ts}/. we log: outputs.jsonl, token_traces.tar.gz, metrics.json, diff_report.html

ci-bot: deploy: starting eval-harness job (run id 2234567890-1)

maria: quick reminder of CLI we use:
```
eval-harness run --model model-omega-v2 --suite mini_accept --samples 500 --quant q4_0 --out s3://redwood-evals/mini-contrasts/omega-v2/${run_ts}
```

david: for canary sizing: if pass, canary=50 reqs over 24h; if marginal, hold and run extended 2k-sample stress suite.

lee: rollback criteria during canary should include >=2% live user regression on instr-follow or any >5 user-facing hallucination reports.

eva: for reporting, create a single-line summary we can paste into release notes: e.g. "omega-v2 q4_0: PASS (instr-follow +1.1%, emb drop 0.9%, p95 +12%)" or "MARGINAL — CI crosses threshold, see diff_report.html"

maria: i'll run the first pass tonight, tagging the run 'mini-contrasts-omega-2024-10-18'. will post a quick summary when job finishes.

sasha: pls also flag any examples where quantization changed the answer class (e.g., from code to text) — we want to catch formatting regressions early.

maria: noted. post-run checklist i will follow:
1) verify exit_code == 0 and metrics.json exists
2) check bootstrap CI for top metrics
3) inspect any failed prompts (open in quickdiff viewer)
4) upload a short run-summary note to the model intake ticket
5) mark canary plan (pass/marginal/fail)

lee: thanks — that checklist is great. i can help review failed prompts if you need a second pair of eyes.

maria: appreciated. tagging @david for approval on thresholds; if no objections by EOD we go ahead. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: job completed (run id 2234567890-1) — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/mini-contrasts/omega-v2/2234567890-1/; metrics.json indicates instr-follow 91.3% (baseline 93.0%), emb mean 0.9842, p95 +18%

maria: preliminary: instr-follow delta -1.7% (FAIL threshold is -1.5%), emb drop 1.58% (just over slack), p95 +18% > allowed 20%? wait baseline_p95 *1.2 would be +20% so this is within latency. so overall instr-follow fails by a hair. I'll mark this run as FAIL.

david: bummer. can you pull the 20 worst-failing prompts and paste a short summary?

maria: grabbing top failures now. 5 examples show trimmed code blocks and missing closing tokens after quantization; 8 examples show hallucinated facts on niche topics; remainder are style/regression. I'll attach excerpt in the ticket.

lee: indicate whether these are reproducible on full-precision; if they are new to quantized, we might tune kernel schedule or fallback.

maria: quick check: these failures are unique to q4_0 — fp16 baseline passes. opening a follow-up: adjust quant params, re-run with q4_1 and q5 mixes, and run extended 2k sample.

eva: good plan. add a note to the ticket that marginal vs fail decision requires dev-approval for kernel changes.

maria: will do. thanks all — closing thread until rerun completes.
